ship.name: Ship Dmg Demo
ship.summary: Be wrapped in a UDIF image and read back by three Linux tools
ship.description:
The smallest complete macOS payload gjsify ship can assemble: a launcher, a bundle, a licence, an icon, a desktop entry and an AppStream component.

It exists so the .dmg leg measures the CONTAINER. What the same tree does when it carries a Node interpreter and a relocated GTK closure is the macos-app-selfcontained leg's subject, and that leg runs the app.
